description: The geodata portal of the Liechtenstein national administration, run by the Office for Civil Engineering and Geoinformation, is the public entry point to the principality's spatial data infrastructure. The portal read on 2026-09-28 offers online maps across all themes, further applications of the spatial data infrastructure, the cadastre of public-law restrictions on land ownership (ÖREB), a protected area for obtaining data through a Geoshop, and model documentation. Coverage is Liechtenstein. Access is free for the online maps and cadastre; data downloads go through the Geoshop, whose prices and licence were not read. Caveats: the map themes were not listed on the entry page, and utility networks are usually not public. It supports reference layers and land-use restrictions for hazard exposure studies and building digital twins in Liechtenstein. Related records: the Liechtenstein eTab building tables and data-swissbuildings3d-swisstopo, which covers Liechtenstein buildings in 3D, complement it.
